Decoding the hex in the EXECVE argument reveals `cat /(... )|xargs bash -c` style payload: the a2 value 63617420207C2078617267732062617368202D6320 decodes to "cat  | xargs bash -c " and the proctitle decodes to "bash -c cat  | xargs bash -c ". This is a bash command that pipes output of `cat` into `xargs bash -c`, i.e., a shell pipeline that pipes data into a new bash interpreter to execute it, a common pattern for dynamically executing content.
